verdict.rationale: AI inbox triage is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The pack only shows developer building blocks: Graph APIs to define category lists, set Inbox rules, and flag or change importance. Those are primitives an app could use to build triage, not a product-side AI that auto-labels, categorizes and surfaces what needs attention with steerable, auditable behavior. A community note mentions Copilot in Outlook but says nothing about triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
